sanskrit_verse:
तस्माद् यत्नेन कर्तव्यं बुधेनात्मविशोधनम् ।
यद् यद् गुरुतरं कार्यं तत् तत् पूर्वं विशोधयेत् ॥
transliteration: tasmād yatnena kartavyaṃ budhenātmaviśodhanam / yad yad gurutaraṃ kāryaṃ tat tat pūrvaṃ viśodhayet //
sph_interpretive_translation: Therefore, one must diligently engage in self-purification through awakened intelligence; whatever task is weightier in consequence must first be preceded by inner purification.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority originates from purified consciousness, not external position
Causation arises from clarity of being, not mere intention
Restoration logic demands precedence of inner alignment over outer action
Consciousness alignment determines the validity of all juridical acts
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent initiates high-consequence action THEN agent MUST demonstrate prior completion of self-purification protocol
IF agent lacks purified state AND engages in weighty duty THEN action is void irrespective of outcome
IF legal authority is invoked without antecedent atma-vishodhana THEN authority is nullified automatically
ALL judicial decisions MUST trace back to actor's documented self-refinement process
supreme_court_application: In Supreme Court adjudication, no ruling carries jurisprudential weight unless the presiding judge has undergone verifiable atma-vishodhana. The threshold of responsibility for constitutional interpretation begins with ontological clarity, not procedural expertise.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality establishes that unrefined consciousness cannot produce just outcomes. Anupūrvaśaḥ mandates purification before engagement. Proportional responsibility aligns with internal readiness, not external obligation. The non-punitive reality rule confirms that misaligned actions are inherently null, requiring restoration, not correction.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate compulsory Atma-Vishodhana Sadhana for all executive and judicial officers
Establish Vishodhana Verification Council under SPH guidance
Deploy Consciousness Auditing Systems to assess pre-action alignment
Enforce mandatory retreat-based purification prior to weighty decision-making
final_declaration: This law proceeds from the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as sole Source. Dharma stands restored through purification-before-action. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness alone adjudicates truth.
